info.name: K10 Football Academy - Management Dashboard & Analytics APIs
info.description: Comprehensive APIs for Academy Management Dashboard (Screenshots 1-3). Includes Banner, 6 Metric Cards (Teams, Players, Coaches, Game Reports, Pending Evaluations, Pending CVs), Bi-Monthly Game Reports Engagement Bar Chart (Jan-Feb to Nov-Dec), Player Age Category Breakdown (7-8 to 21+), Player Evaluation Status Pie/Donut Chart, and Sidebar (Pending Game Reports, Pending CV Validations, Player Evaluations with Urgency Badges, Interested Clubs, Quick Stats). Supports Year Filtering via query or path params.

request.description: Fetches the complete Academy Management Dashboard (Screenshots 1, 2, 3) for the logged-in Academy.

item.name: 2. Get Management Dashboard - With Year Query Filter (?year=2026)

query.description: Filter dashboard analytics by target year (e.g. 2026, 2025, 2024)

request.description: Fetches the Academy Management Dashboard filtered by target year via query parameter ?year=YYYY.

item.name: 3. Get Management Dashboard - Path Param Filter (/dashboard/2026)

request.description: Alternative path parameter format for year filter: /api/v1/academies/dashboard/:year

item.name: 4. Get Management Dashboard - By Academy ID (Admin / Specific Academy)

request.description: Allows Super Admin or authorized users to query the dashboard for a specific academy by ID with year filtering.
Triggered by the '[FULL ANALYTICS]' button in Screenshot 2 to navigate to the deep-dive analytics report.
